title: Teriyaki Tofu Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Noodles
description: Want a wholesome, healthy dinner in a flash? With plenty of veggies, noodles and golden crisp tofu stir-fried in a delicious teriyaki sauce, this fits the bill nicely.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Carefully remove the tofu according to the packet instructions, then drain on paper towel. Coarsely chop the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks. Cut the head into small florets. Peel the carrot and thinly slice on an angle. Thinly slice the spring onion on an angle. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove.

Cook noodles: Cook half the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 4 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Meanwhile, put the teriyaki sauce, 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp honey and 2 tsp water in a bowl and whisk well to combine.

Cook tofu: Cut the tofu into 2cm-thick batons (see Kitchen tip), then season with salt and pepper. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Add the broccoli stem, broccoli florets, carrot and garlic to the pan and stir-fry for 6-7 mins until the vegetables are just tender. Add the sauce mixture, bring to the boil and cook for 1 min. Add the noodles and half the spring onion and stir to combine. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the noodle stir-fry among bowls and top with the tofu. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds and remaining spring onion and enjoy.
Kitchen tip: Don't worry if the tofu breaks up a little when you cut it, as it will still taste just as good. And if you have one, use a non-stick frypan when cooking the tofu.
